"Stuck on You!"  was the third in a series of four "sexy comedies" that helped establish Troma, beginning with 1979's smash hit "Squeeze Play! ", 1981's "Waitress! ", and followed by 1983's "The First Turn-On! ".

Tromeo and Juliet | Tromeo and Juliet is a 1996 American independent transgressive romantic comedy film and a loose adaptation of William Shakespeare's "Romeo & Juliet" from Troma Entertainment.  The film was directed by Lloyd Kaufman from a screenplay by Kaufman and James Gunn, who also served as associate director.
